_comment: L3 label data only — never derived from chain. originId/certId hex values here are just deterministic UTF-8-padded Bytes<32> (same encoding as contract/e2e/run.ts's bytes32() helper), not secrets. POST /admin/origins with a new label appends a runtime entry to agent/.state/registry-runtime.json (gitignored), merged over this seed at read time — this file itself is never mutated by the running agent.
